title: Lampu Buah Naga
subject: a Banyuwangi dragon-fruit farmer who lights his field with yellow lamps from six till five to force off-season flowers, watches his electricity bill double, and ends up charging the courting teenagers who sneak in at night five thousand rupiah to take photos among the glowing poles
caption: Kendang kempul Banyuwangi, the gandrung-rooted East Javanese regional pop that crosses Osing tradition with dangdut. A Banyuwangi kendang playing crisp, choppy slap patterns that sound nothing like a koplo kendang; a kempul gong landing on the backbeat; a kluncing triangle ringing steady eighths; a gandrung-style violin playing sliding slendro-flavoured fills between every vocal line; a reedy electric organ and a plain electric bass holding the groove. Dry, close regional-studio mix with the kendang upfront and only a short room reverb on the violin. Male mid-range lead with a bright, nasal village-singer tone, short gandrung-style ornaments at the ends of lines, chatty and teasing delivery. 124 BPM, A minor. Cheeky, bouncy and proud. No koplo breakdowns, no EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rock guitar, no Western pop chord ballad.
lyrics:
[Intro - gandrung violin, kluncing triangle and a kendang roll]

[Verse 1]
Jam enam sore isun tekan sakelar
Seribu lampu kuning nyala satu kebun
Pohon naga nggak tahu ini bukan musimnya
Dikira masih siang, terus aja berbunga

[Pre-Chorus]
Tagihan listrik datang, istriku baca dua kali
Katanya kebun kita lebih terang dari kantor bupati

[Chorus]
Lampu buah naga, nyala sampai subuh
Bunganya mekar, yang pacaran ikut kumpul
Riko yang di pojok, isun lihat lho
Foto boleh, bayar lima ribu

[Verse 2]
Malam Minggu motor parkir di pematang
Anak SMA bawa tripod sama pacarnya
Ada yang berlutut di antara tiang beton
Cincinnya jatuh, dicari pakai senterku

[Chorus]
Lampu buah naga, nyala sampai subuh
Bunganya mekar, cincinnya ketemu
Riko berdua, isun jadi saksi
Foto boleh, bayar lima ribu

[Bridge - kendang and kempul alone, then violin]
Bunga naga cuma mekar satu malam saja
Persis kayak janji anak SMA

[Chorus]
Lampu buah naga, mati waktu subuh
Bunganya kuncup, pacarnya pada pulang
Tinggal isun sendiri ngitung lima ribuan
Lumayan buat nyicil tagihan

[Outro - violin flourish, kempul hit, kendang stop]
